_comment: Tool arms for the generated-task harness (npm run harness). Each arm runs alone: its MCP server is the only one loaded (--strict-mcp-config), on top of the same built-in Read/Grep/Glob every arm gets. Placeholders: ${NODE} ${PROJECT_ROOT} ${REPO_DIR} ${TSCONFIG} ${RIE_DB}. `setup` names a preparation step the harness knows how to run before any agent starts. A CLI competitor (no MCP server) can instead set builtin_tools (default Read,Grep,Glob), path_prepend, env and system_note - the note plays the role an MCP server's tool descriptions play for its arm. Every such setting is recorded in each results file's meta.tool_launch.

baseline.description: No MCP server - built-in Read/Grep/Glob only.

rie.description: Repository Intelligence Engine, prebuilt index of the target repo.

bash-madge.description: Built-in Read/Grep/Glob plus Bash, with madge 8.0.0 (the common circular-dependency CLI) on PATH and configured to skip `import type` statements. The fair competitor for cycle tasks: what a developer with a shell would reach for.
bash-madge.system_note: The `madge` CLI (v8.0.0) is installed and on PATH, configured to skip `import type` statements. For example, to list import cycles: madge --circular --extensions ts,tsx --ts-config tsconfig.rie.json src
